# 根据当前工具链推导 GCC C++ multilib 头文件目录。
execute_process(
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" -print-sysroot
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE ARM_GCC_SYSROOT
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    ERROR_QUIET
)
if(ARM_GCC_SYSROOT STREQUAL "")
    get_filename_component(ARM_GCC_BIN_DIR "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(ARM_GCC_ROOT "${ARM_GCC_BIN_DIR}" DIRECTORY)
    set(ARM_GCC_SYSROOT "${ARM_GCC_ROOT}/arm-none-eabi")
endif()
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${ARM_GCC_SYSROOT}" ARM_GCC_SYSROOT)
execute_process(
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" -dumpfullversion
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE ARM_GCC_VERSION
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    ERROR_QUIET
)
if(ARM_GCC_VERSION STREQUAL "")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" -dumpversion
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE ARM_GCC_VERSION
        OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
        COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
    )
endif()
execute_process(
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
        -mfloat-abi=hard
        -mthumb
        -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
        -mcpu=cortex-m4
        -mlittle-endian
        -print-multi-directory
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE ARM_GCC_MULTILIB
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
)
string(REPLACE "\\" "/" ARM_GCC_MULTILIB "${ARM_GCC_MULTILIB}")
set(ARM_GXX_STDINC "${ARM_GCC_SYSROOT}/include/c++/${ARM_GCC_VERSION}")
set(ARM_GXX_TARGET_STDINC "${ARM_GXX_STDINC}/arm-none-eabi")
set(ARM_GXX_MULTILIB_STDINC "${ARM_GXX_TARGET_STDINC}/${ARM_GCC_MULTILIB}")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ARM_GXX_MULTILIB_STDINC}/bits/c++config.h")
    set(ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB "${ARM_GCC_MULTILIB}")
    string(REPLACE "v7e-m+fp/" "v7+fp/" ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB "${ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB}")
    string(REPLACE "v7e-m+dp/" "v7+fp/" ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB "${ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB}")
    if(EXISTS "${ARM_GXX_TARGET_STDINC}/${ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB}/bits/c++config.h")
        set(ARM_GXX_MULTILIB_STDINC "${ARM_GXX_TARGET_STDINC}/${ARM_GCC_COMPAT_MULTILIB}")
    endif()
endif()

foreach(FIRMWARE_TARGET IN LISTS FIRMWARE_TARGETS)
target_include_directories(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} SYSTEM PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:${ARM_GXX_MULTILIB_STDINC}>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:${ARM_GXX_TARGET_STDINC}>"
)

target_compile_options(${FIRMWARE_TARGET} PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:-include>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/gcc_compat.h>"
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -fno-common
    -pipe
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -funsigned-char
    -fshort-enums
    -fshort-wchar
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto-partition=1to1>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-Og>"
    "$<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:${KEIL_OPTIMIZATION_FLAG}>"
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-std=c99>
    "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g2>"
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:-x>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:assembler-with-cpp>
)
endforeach()

# Boot is pure C and must match the GNU runtime ABI rather than the AC5
# compatibility setting used by the legacy/App targets.
target_compile_options(X_Track_Boot PRIVATE
    -fno-short-wchar
    -Werror
)

target_link_options(X_Track PRIVATE
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto-partition=1to1>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultDump>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultHook>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultTrace>"
    -T${LINKER_SCRIPT}
    "-L${LINKER_SCRIPT_DIR}"
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,--relax
    -Wl,--require-defined=Reset_Handler
    -Wl,-Map=${MAP_FILE}
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage
    -specs=nano.specs
    -specs=nosys.specs
    -u _printf_float
)

target_link_options(X_Track_App_GCC PRIVATE
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-flto-partition=1to1>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultDump>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultHook>"
    "$<$<AND:$<BOOL:${KEIL_GCC_ENABLE_LTO}>,$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>>:-Wl,--undefined=vApplicationHardFaultTrace>"
    -T${APP_LINKER_SCRIPT}
    "-L${APP_OUTPUT_DIR}"
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,--relax
    -Wl,--require-defined=Reset_Handler
    -Wl,-Map=${APP_MAP_FILE}
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage
    -specs=nano.specs
    -specs=nosys.specs
    -u _printf_float
)

target_link_options(X_Track_Boot PRIVATE
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    -T${BOOT_LINKER_SCRIPT}
    "-L${BOOT_OUTPUT_DIR}"
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,--relax
    -Wl,--require-defined=Reset_Handler
    -Wl,-Map=${BOOT_MAP_FILE}
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage
    -nostartfiles
    -specs=nano.specs
    -specs=nosys.specs
)

target_link_libraries(X_Track PRIVATE
    "m"
)

target_link_libraries(X_Track_App_GCC PRIVATE
    "m"
)

add_custom_command(TARGET X_Track_App_GCC POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O ihex "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_App_GCC>" "${APP_HEX_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O binary "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_App_GCC>" "${APP_BIN_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_SIZE}" --format=berkeley "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_App_GCC>"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch "${APP_ARTIFACT_STAMP}"
    COMMENT "Generating isolated OTA App artifacts"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_command(TARGET X_Track_Boot POST_BUILD
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O ihex "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_Boot>" "${BOOT_HEX_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O binary "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_Boot>" "${BOOT_BIN_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_SIZE}" --format=berkeley "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track_Boot>"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch "${BOOT_ARTIFACT_STAMP}"
    COMMENT "Generating isolated OTA Boot artifacts"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(X_Track_artifacts ALL
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O ihex "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track>" "${HEX_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_OBJCOPY}" -O binary "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track>" "${BIN_FILE}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_SIZE}" --format=berkeley "$<TARGET_FILE:X_Track>"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E touch "${ARTIFACT_STAMP}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
        "-DINPUT_FILE=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json"
        "-DOUTPUT_FILE=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/compile_commands.json"
        -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/copy_if_exists.cmake"
    DEPENDS X_Track
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    VERBATIM
)
